mass_convention: Solar and Jupiter masses are educational conversion values from nominal GM divided by G (IAU 2015 B3); not exact physical masses. G follows CODATA 2022.

harps.profile: Gaussian approximation for this lesson, NOT the measured HARPS line-spread function
harps.source_note: ESO overview gives nominal R=115000; pipeline manual 3.3.12 lists measured R=120000 and 4.1 px/FWHM. Presets identify these separately; Gaussian lesson profile is not the measured HARPS LSF.

slab.disclosure: Generic Fe-like teaching atom, not an identified real transition. Single-temperature LTE Saha–Boltzmann absorbing screen, no line emission, continuum opacity, damping, blends, NLTE or 3D. Set T=Teff and ne=1e19×10^(logg−4.44)×5772/T as an explicit schematic pressure proxy; no calibrated stellar atmosphere or grid interpolation.
